notes.title: 1.0.2Update Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h3][b]New Additions[/b][/h3][list][*][p][spoiler]Special Egg display in encyclopedia[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p][spoiler]Added 24 types of special egg (now each chicken has special egg) [/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]Background mute function in the settings menu[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Optimizations[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved tutorial text descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the duration of chick needs during the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Improved needle injection and bandage prompts in the hospital[/p][/*][*][p]Added digit separators to coins for easier readability[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Steam achievements were not unlocking (they will now automatically unlock upon re-entering the corresponding farm)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where chick needs could not be fulfilled during playtime in the tutorial[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks.[/p]
